text:
Asha Patel: Heads-up — QBR/EBR with NeonHealth next Tue 09:00 PT. Need final slide deck + enablement ask list. Top items: renewal risk (usage dip), onboarding blockers (SAML), exec demo, and feedback remediation. Reply with owners and any blockers.
Evan Cho: I can own usage & cost slide. Who has the 30d token spend + top endpoints?
Priya Nair: I’ll own onboarding blockers + runbook. Quick update: SAML PR merged (gh/infra#234), waiting on infra deploy ETA Fri EOD.
Marco Ruiz: I’ll take exec demo + demo script. Need two example prompts and a short fallback plan if latency spikes.
CSBot: Template reminder: QBR deck template available at https://redwood.internal/qbr-templates. Autofill: customer=NeonHealth, renewal_date=2026-06-01.
Asha Patel: Action items summary: Evan: usage slide (Due Thu 17:00 PT). Priya: onboarding status & runbook (Due Fri EOD). Marco: demo + cues (Due Mon 09:00 PT). I will synthesize deck and run exec dry-run Mon 11:00 PT. Please paste any customer asks here.
Evan Cho: Quick ask 12 — can we include a small table with last 30d token spend + top 10 endpoints? Priya, can you pull or point to dashboard?
Priya Nair: I can pull the numbers but need a billing API key. Pinging eng-sre in separate thread. If not by Thu morning, I’ll export from Billing UI.
Marco Ruiz: Note on renewal risk: usage dip seems tied to a competitor pilot started 2 weeks ago (flagged in CS notes). We should prepare pricing/commitment options to propose. :warning:
Asha Patel: Add enablement ask: 30-min training for their 12 engineers + runbook handoff. Who can host the session? @Marco?
Priya Nair: I can host the 30-min walkthrough for onboarding steps (incl. SAML checklist). Marco will handle exec demo.
Evan Cho: Deck link: https://slack.redwood/qbrs/neonhealth/draft-v1 — started slide 3 (usage). Please add comments in slide notes.
CSBot: Dry-run scheduled: Mon 11:00 PT. Invite sent to primary execs + CSMs (Asha, Marco, CSM lead).
Asha Patel: Capturing items in Asana: https://app.asana/0/12345/67890. Also capturing survey feedback: NPS 6, main themes: onboarding friction + billing clarity. Need remediation bullets.
Marco Ruiz: :thumbsup: I’ll draft remediation bullets and a short script for the exec ask. Also need NeonHealth escalation contact — can someone confirm?
Priya Nair: I’ll confirm the escalation contact in tomorrow’s onboarding sync and post here.
Evan Cho: One more: include 3 alternative pricing models (flex burst, committed baseline, enterprise seat) with rough numbers. I’ll draft the table.
Asha Patel: Perfect. Final check: any blocked on assets? If not, we’ll lock slides Fri 18:00 PT and run the dry-run Mon 11:00 PT.
Marco Ruiz: No blockers from me.
Priya Nair: Waiting on infra deploy for SAML smoke tests, but that shouldn’t block slides.
Evan Cho: I’m good, will post the usage CSV by Thu AM.
Asha Patel: Thanks team — I’ll compile and send the pre-read to the execs by Mon 08:00 PT.
